title: POV: You Left My Reel On Seen
source: Creator-selected jam idea #4 (2026-06-11), preserved and repaired by idea room
one_line_concept: Aachu sends Zuv a reel and audits his reaction time with escalating side-eye, until the pivot reveals he saves her reels to watch together at night.
draft_on_image_text: POV: I sent you a reel 0.2 seconds ago
and you're laughing at YOUR phone
you watched it. and said NOTHING.
...you were sending me the SAME reel.
text_note: Slide text is a draft; final wording locked at story/prompt stages. Slides 1-3 sender-voice comedic, slide 4 warm behavioral pivot.
why_it_wins: Preserves the creator's exact premise and sequel energy to the proven couple-banter post.
Fills the page's missing format: multi-slide escalation with a real turn.
Joke is acted by faces (side-eye), which is the page's strongest, most identity-safe visual device.
Pivot converts complaint into 'us', driving sends WITH affection and saves, not just likes.
Camera distance closes slide by slide, giving every swipe a mechanical reason.
risks: Side-eye must stay playful; any genuinely angry read fails the affection rule (couple-banter lesson, cited in memory_recall.md).
Slide 3 close-up is the identity-drift hot zone; face must stay reference-driven under exaggerated eye acting.
No rendered phone UI; screens implied by glow only.
Pivot slide must show the saved-for-later behavior visually (night, blanket, one phone between them), not state it in text alone.
creator_revision: Slide 3 text replaced: original 'I can see the seen. I am seeing you.' was unclear (wordplay needed explanation). Locked: 'you watched it. and said NOTHING.' Beat unchanged: opened-but-no-reaction.
